title: DroneSafetyState
description: Records the governance response AND the physical response for a given failure condition (v0.3 §18 T5-05). DENY is a governance verdict, not a physical action — this schema keeps the two explicitly separate so they are never conflated.

governance_response.description: What DROS decides, e.g. 'DENY new privileged action', 'DENY / isolate'.

physical_response.description: What the flight-control/safety architecture actually does as a result — e.g. hover, controlled hold, RTL, controlled landing, mission abort, capability reduction. This is owned by the flight-safety architecture, not asserted unilaterally by DROS (v0.3 §5 Level E).

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the artifact in DRONE_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json that supports this row.
